detailed_description: The Multi-Currency Net Worth & Asset Allocation Tracker is designed to systematically analyze and stress-test your overall household wealth structure. Modeled in a Swiss private banking minimal dark gold theme, it supports detailed categorization across liquid assets, non-liquid assets, investment assets, and liabilities. With dynamic multi-currency conversions and dual-slider price sensitivity simulations for stocks and real estate, you can stress-test your net worth and receive institutional-grade debt ratios and health diagnoses on the big screen.
usage_steps: Enter your initial amounts and select currencies for liquid, non-liquid, and investment assets, along with liabilities on the left panel.
Toggle your primary valuation currency (CNY / USD / EUR), and the system automatically converts all values with dynamic exchange rates.
Inspect your family asset-liability donut chart above the lists, rendered in high-end ECharts minimal bronze gold colors.
Drag the sensitivity analysis sliders for stock price volatility (-50% to +50%) and real estate price changes (-30% to +30%).
Observe real-time smooth net worth value updates and immediate responses on the 4-stage matte asset health indicator on the right panel.
Evaluate your liquidity and debt-to-asset ratios to determine the optimum leverage ratio to hedge against potential financial risks.
usage_examples: Simulate whether your liquid cash reserves can cover all outstanding credit card debts if the stock market crashes by 30%.
Assess whether your household debt-to-asset ratio exceeds the critical red safety margin of 70% if real estate prices drop by 20%.
Input multi-currency mixed assets and switch the base currency to evaluate currency fluctuation impacts on your total family net worth.
Review if your liquidity ratio lies in the gold robust zone when excluding illiquid physical assets like your primary residence.

faqs.question: Why separate liquid, non-liquid, and investment assets?
faqs.answer: Liquid assets (like savings) represent your ability to meet emergency expenses; non-liquid assets (like homes) take time to cash out; investment assets (like stocks) carry volatility. Reasonable division clarifies liquidity risks.

faqs.question: How do the sensitivity stress-test sliders work?
faqs.answer: Sliders let you simulate percentage fluctuations in stock or real estate prices. The calculator recalculates investments and physical assets, updating simulated net worth and health indicators in real-time.

faqs.question: What is a healthy debt-to-asset ratio?
faqs.answer: A healthy household debt-to-asset ratio is typically between 20% and 50% (balanced). If it exceeds 70%, it indicates high financial leverage and elevated risks of negative equity during market recessions.

faqs.question: Which main currencies are supported for conversion?
faqs.answer: We support CNY, USD, and EUR seamlessly with dynamic conversion rates, adhering strictly to strict financial engineering foreign exchange calculation rules.

faqs.question: Are my assets, liabilities, and financial privacy safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. This tracker runs 100% locally in your web browser. All entered amounts, currency exchange metrics, and stress-test data are stored in memory and never uploaded to any server, securing your 100% financial privacy.
